_comment: Intentional design, not defects. Each entry must state why. A tool that cannot be told 'this is on purpose' gets muted and then ignored entirely, so keep this list short and justified. Remove an entry the moment the design changes.

ignore.why: Ghosted echo of the hero headline at 119px, 42% opacity. Decorative watermark by design (verified visually), not body copy. WCAG does not exempt decoration, but failing it would push the design toward a heavier ghost that contradicts the brand.
Second ghosted headline line at 92px, 35% opacity. Same deliberate watermark treatment as span.l2.
